title: onboardingSystem document
description: A widget document of onboardingSystem: one root widget and its slot children. Structure only; compile the Blueprint for the authoritative diagnostics.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: The wizard title per language and, optionally, the index of the step it opens on.

steps.description: The steps in order: AccountStep, InterestsStep, SafetyStep or InductionStep. At least one.

widget_Onboarding.description: The root of the onboarding wizard. State: `current` (the index of the current step) and `finished`. Properties: `title`, `steps` (each step's title, `complete` and `missing`), `progress` and `answers`. Methods: `canEnter(index)` (read-only), `next()`, `back()`, `goTo(index)` (each writes `current` and emits `stepChanged`) and `finish()` (emits `completed`). A refused move is a Method diagnostic and changes nothing.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: The step title per language and, optionally, the name and e-mail address filled in at the start.

widget_AccountStep.description: Step 1 of the onboarding wizard: the visitor's name and e-mail address (State `name` and `email`, filled in as they type). Properties: `title`, `missing` (`name` and/or `email` while they are empty or not an address), `complete` and `answers`.

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: The step title, the options (an id and a label per language), how many must be picked and which are picked at the start.

widget_InterestsStep.description: Step 2 of the onboarding wizard: the interests the new member picks from the configured options (State `selected`: the picked ids). Properties: `title`, `options`, `missing` (`interests:<n>` while `n` more must be picked to reach `minimum`), `complete` and `answers` (the picked ids).

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: The step title, the safety rules (an id and a text per language) and which are acknowledged at the start.

widget_SafetyStep.description: Step 3 of the onboarding wizard: the safety briefing. The visitor acknowledges each configured rule (State `acknowledged`: the ids acknowledged so far). Properties: `title`, `rules`, `missing` (one `rule:<id>` per rule not yet acknowledged), `complete` and `answers` (the acknowledged ids).

meta.description: Reserved for tools: any JSON value, never interpreted by Core.

config.description: The step title and the days and start times offered. Whether the booking office still has room is not known here: the host asks it.

widget_InductionStep.description: Step 4 of the onboarding wizard: booking an induction slot, with the work kept at the host. Methods: `requestSlot(date, time)` (validated against the config; writes the request into State and emits `slotRequested` with a ticket), `settleBooking(ticket, outcome)` (the host's answer; applied only if the ticket is still the newest, otherwise ignored) and `cancelBooking()` (emits `slotCancelled`); `requestSlot` and `cancelBooking` are refused once the wizard is finished. Events: `slotRequested`, `slotConfirmed`, `slotDeclined`, `slotCancelled`. State: `status`, `ticket`, `slot`, `reference`, `reason`.

type_BookingOutcome.description: What the booking office answers for a request.

type_Completion.description: The payload of the root's `completed` Event: every step's own `answers`, by step id.

type_I18nText.description: Text per language, `{ "en": "...", "zh-TW": "..." }`. `en` is required; a missing language falls back to it.

type_InductionAnswers.description: What the induction step contributes to the `completed` Event.

days.description: The days an induction can be booked, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

times.description: The start times offered on each day, `HH:MM`.

minimum.description: How many interests the visitor must pick (default 1).

preselected.description: The ids picked at the start.

startStep.description: The index of the step the wizard opens on (0 = the first).

current.description: The index of the current step.

firstIncomplete.description: The first step that is not complete, or -1 when every step is.

furthest.description: The furthest step the visitor may enter: the first incomplete one (or the last when all are complete).

type_Progress.description: Where the wizard is, and how far the visitor may go.

acknowledged.description: The ids of the rules acknowledged at the start.

wasConfirmed.description: `true` when the booking had been confirmed already, `false` when the request was still waiting for an answer.

ticket.description: The ticket of this request: an answer is applied only while it is still the newest.

type_SlotCancelled.description: The payload of `slotCancelled`: the request or booking the visitor gave up.

type_SlotRequest.description: The payload of the induction's `slotRequested` Event: what the host is asked to book.

type_StepChange.description: The payload of the root's `stepChanged` Event.

missing.description: What is still missing, as machine-readable codes (`name`, `email`, `interests`, `rule:<id>`, `booking`, ...).
